shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin dropped below $76K amid a US tech sell-off, triggering over $1B in liquidations.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw more than $430M in net outflows on Nov 5, pushing YTD flows into negative territory.
Ongoing fallout and concerns from the $6.3B Binance hack continue to dampen market sentiment.
Democratic midterm wins sparked concerns over tighter AI regulation, negatively impacting tech and crypto sectors.
US initial jobless claims fell to 189,000, signaling a resilient labor market.
